claims.claim: In transgenic mice harboring green florescent protein under the control of the Sox2 promoter, less than ten percent of the cells with green florescent colocalize with cell proliferation markers.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions that Sox2-GFP cells differ in proliferation levels, but does not provide any specific percentage regarding colocalization with cell proliferation markers.

claims.claim: In young and middle-aged adults, current or remote uses of ADHD medications do not increase the risk of serious cardiovascular events.

attempts.rationale: The study concludes that among young and middle-aged adults, current or new use of ADHD medications was not associated with an increased risk of serious cardiovascular events compared to nonuse or remote use.

claims.claim: Incidence of heart failure decreased by 10% in women since 1979.

attempts.rationale: The study found that the incidence of heart failure did not change over time among men or women between 1979 and 2000, contradicting the claim that it decreased by 10% in women.

claims.claim: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.

attempts.rationale: The abstracts demonstrate that incidence rates of cervical cancer have declined significantly, falling from 15.4 to 2.7 per 100,000 woman-years following screening programs.

claims.claim: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have increased due to nationwide screening programs based primarily on cytology to detect uterine cervical cancer.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract reports that incidence and mortality rates of cervical cancer declined, but it does not evaluate whether nationwide cytology-based screening programs caused an increase in cervical cancer incidence.

claims.claim: Increased microtubule acetylation repairs LRRK2 Roc-COR domain mutation induced locomotor deficits.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that LRRK2 Roc-COR domain mutations cause locomotor deficits, and increasing microtubule acetylation via deacetylase inhibitors or knockdown rescues this locomotor behavior in vivo.

claims.claim: Increased vessel density along with a reduction in fibrosis decreases the efficacy of chemotherapy treatments.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses increased vascular density improving chemotherapy delivery and stabilization, but it does not mention a reduction in fibrosis, leaving insufficient information to evaluate the claim.

claims.claim: Individuals with low serum vitamin D concentrations have increased risk of multiple sclerosis.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses sun exposure and ultraviolet radiation in relation to multiple sclerosis risk, but does not provide evidence or mention serum vitamin D concentrations.

claims.claim: Infection of human T-cell lymphotropic virus type 1 is most frequent in individuals of African origin.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions that HTLV-I infection is endemic in Japan, the Caribbean, Africa, and Melanesia, but does not provide evidence indicating it is most frequent in individuals of African origin.

claims.claim: Inositol lipid 3-phosphatase PTEN converts Ptdlns(3,4)P 2 into phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate.

attempts.rationale: The abstract indicates that PTEN functions as a PI(3,4)P2 3-phosphatase, but it does not specifically state that it converts PtdIns(3,4)P2 into phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate.

claims.claim: Input from  mental and physical health care professionals is effective at decreasing homelessness.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract evaluates the mental health needs and social support of families before and after rehousing, but does not provide evidence on whether input from mental and physical health care professionals is effective at reducing homelessness.

claims.claim: Insomnia can be effectively treated with cognitive behavioral therapy.

attempts.rationale: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) was shown to improve short- and long-term sleep efficiency and reduce wake time, effectively managing insomnia in older adults.

claims.claim: Insulin increases risk of severe kidney failure.

attempts.rationale: Although insulin is mentioned as one of the investigated exposures, the abstract does not report any results regarding insulin's specific effect on the risk of severe kidney failure.

claims.claim: Integrating classroom-based collaborative learning with Web-based collaborative learning leads to subpar class performance

attempts.rationale: The provided text discusses general arguments for computer-assisted learning in medical education, but does not provide information on whether integrating classroom-based and Web-based collaborative learning causes subpar class performance.

claims.claim: Ivermectin is used to treat lymphatic filariasis.

attempts.rationale: The provided text discusses lymphatic filariasis as a neglected tropical disease, but it does not mention ivermectin or its use as a treatment.

claims.claim: Ivermectin is used to treat onchocerciasis.

attempts.rationale: The provided text discusses the control and characteristics of neglected tropical diseases including onchocerciasis, but does not mention ivermectin or its use as a treatment.

claims.claim: LDL cholesterol has no involvement in the development of cardiovascular disease.

attempts.rationale: The abstract directly states that LDL cholesterol has a causal role in the development of cardiovascular disease, contradicting the claim that it has no involvement.

claims.claim: Lack of clpC does not affect sporulation efficiency in Bacillus subtilis cells.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses a genetic screen for sporulation genes in Bacillus subtilis but does not mention clpC or its effect on sporulation efficiency.

claims.claim: Less than 10% of the gabonese children with Schimmelpenning-Feuerstein-Mims syndrome (SFM) had a plasma lactate of more than 5mmol/L.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses children with malaria and mentions hyperlactataemia, but it does not mention Schimmelpenning-Feuerstein-Mims syndrome or the proportion of children with a plasma lactate of more than 5 mmol/L.

claims.claim: Leukemia associated Rho guanine nucleotide-exchange factor represses RhoA in response to SRC activation.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions that LARG is activated by the Src family kinase Fyn, but it does not state whether LARG represses or activates RhoA in response to SRC activation.

claims.claim: Leuko-increased blood increases infectious complications in red blood cell transfusion.

attempts.rationale: The abstract investigates the effects of leukoreduction rather than leuko-increased blood, and it specifically finds that leukoreduction did not result in a significant decrease in serious nosocomial infections.

claims.claim: Leuko-reduced blood reduces infectious complications in red blood cell transfusion.

attempts.rationale: The study found that following the introduction of leukoreduction for red blood cell transfusions, serious nosocomial infections did not decrease.

claims.claim: Localization of PIN1 in the Arabidopsis embryo does not require VPS9a

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses PIN polarization and the Rab5 GTPase pathway during embryogenesis but does not mention VPS9a or its role in PIN1 localization.

claims.claim: Localization of PIN1 in the roots of Arabidopsis does not require VPS9a

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses PIN polarity and Rab5 GTPase pathway in Arabidopsis, but does not mention VPS9a or its role in PIN1 localization.

claims.claim: Low expression of miR7a does represses target genes and exerts a biological function in ovaries.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract investigates the ceRNA hypothesis and miR-122 in hepatocytes and liver tissue, offering no information regarding miR7a expression or its function in ovaries.

claims.claim: Low expression of miR7a exerts a biological function in testis.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses miR-122 and target site abundance in hepatocytes and livers, but contains no information regarding miR7a or its function in the testis.

claims.claim: Low nucleosome occupancy correlates with low methylation levels across species.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses clustered DNA methylation in nucleosome linkers disfavoring nucleosomes in specific Dnmt5-containing organisms, but it does not address whether low nucleosome occupancy correlates with low methylation levels across species.

claims.claim: Lupus-prone mice infected with curliproducing bacteria have higher autoantibody titers compared to controls.

attempts.rationale: Doc 1834762 directly states that the infection of lupus-prone mice with curli-producing bacteria triggered higher autoantibody titers compared to curli-deficient bacteria.

claims.claim: Ly49Q directs the organization of neutrophil migration to inflammation sites by regulating membrane raft functions.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that Ly49Q regulates membrane raft functions to mediate neutrophil polarization and rapid migration upon inflammation.

claims.claim: Ly6C hi monocytes have a lower inflammatory capacity compared to their Ly6C lo counterparts.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses the lineage and fate mapping of Ly6C(+) and Ly6C(-) monocytes but does not provide any information regarding their inflammatory capacity.

claims.claim: Ly6C hi monocytes have a lower inflammatory capacity than Ly6C lo monocytes.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses the recruitment and maturation of Ly-6C subsets under inflammatory conditions, but it does not compare the inflammatory capacity between Ly6C hi and Ly6C lo monocytes.

claims.claim: Lymphadenopathy is observed in knockin mouse lacking the SHP-2 MAPK pathway.

attempts.rationale: While the abstract indicates that SHP2 signal-deficient knockin mice displayed lymphadenopathy, it does not explicitly mention the MAPK pathway.

claims.claim: Macrolides have no protective effect against myocardial infarction.

attempts.rationale: The study found no effect on the risk of developing a first-time acute myocardial infarction for the previous use of macrolides, supporting the claim that they have no protective effect.

claims.claim: Macrolides protect against myocardial infarction.

attempts.rationale: The study found no effect on the risk of developing acute myocardial infarction for previous use of macrolides, contradicting the claim that macrolides protect against it.

claims.claim: Macropinocytosis contributes to a cell's supply of amino acids via the intracellular uptake of protein.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that macropinocytosis of extracellular proteins can serve as an amino acid source and reduce dependence on extracellular amino acids like glutamine.

claims.claim: Many proteins in human cells can be post-translationally modified at lysine residues via acetylation.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explains that lysine acetylation is a reversible post-translational modification on targeted proteins and notes from proteomic studies that it regulates various cellular metabolic processes and is involved in numerous human diseases.

claims.claim: Mathematical models predict that using Artemisinin-based combination therapy over nongametocytocidal drugs have a dramatic impact in reducing malaria transmission.

attempts.rationale: The mathematical modeling findings show that an efficacious antimalarial regimen with no gametocytocidal properties but a long prophylactic time was estimated to be more effective at reducing transmission than a short-acting ACT in high-transmission settings.

claims.claim: Mercaptopurine is anabolized into the inactive methylmercaptopurine by thiopurine methyltrasnferase (TPMT).

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses the role of NT5C2 mutations in resistance to 6-mercaptopurine, but does not mention thiopurine methyltransferase (TPMT) or the conversion of mercaptopurine into methylmercaptopurine.

claims.claim: Metastatic colorectal cancer treated with a single agent fluoropyrimidines resulted in reduced efficacy and lower quality of life when compared with oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy in elderly patients.

attempts.rationale: Although adding oxaliplatin showed a non-significant improvement in progression-free survival, the abstract does not assess quality of life differences between single-agent fluoropyrimidines and oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy.

claims.claim: Mice defective for deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) polymerase I (polI) reveal increased sensitivity to ionizing radiation (IR).

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses DNA polymerases mu, lambda, and TdT during V(D)J recombination, but does not mention DNA polymerase I or ionizing radiation sensitivity.

claims.claim: Mice that lack Interferon-γ or its receptor exhibit high resistance to experimental autoimmune myocarditis.

attempts.rationale: Mice lacking the interferon-gamma receptor develop severe, persistent myocarditis with high mortality rather than exhibiting resistance, indicating that interferon-gamma protects against the disease.

claims.claim: Mice without IFN-γ or its receptor are resistant to EAM induced with α-MyHC/CFA.

attempts.rationale: Rather than being resistant to experimental autoimmune myocarditis, IFN-gamma-deficient mice developed fatal autoimmune disease.

claims.claim: MicroRNA is involved in the regulation of Neural Stem Cell (NSC) differentiation and proliferation dynamic homeostasis

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that the microRNA miR-184 directly regulates the balance between proliferation and differentiation in adult neural stem cells.

claims.claim: Microarray results from culture-amplified mixtures of serotypes correlate poorly with microarray results from uncultured mixtures.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions that microarray with a culture amplification step was the top-performing method, but it does not compare or correlate microarray results of culture-amplified mixtures with those of uncultured mixtures.

claims.claim: Mitochondria are uninvolved in apoptosis.

attempts.rationale: The abstract directly contradicts the claim by stating that mitochondria participate in apoptosis.

claims.claim: Modifying the epigenome in the brain affects the normal human aging process by affecting certain genes related to neurogenesis.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses brain epigenomes in relation to neural development, neurological disease, and aging, but does not state that modifying the epigenome affects the normal human aging process through genes related to neurogenesis.

claims.claim: Monoclonal antibody targeting of N-cadherin inhibits metastasis.

attempts.rationale: In vivo tests demonstrated that monoclonal antibodies targeting the ectodomain of N-cadherin blocked local invasion and metastasis in established CRPC xenografts.

claims.claim: Most termination events in Okazaki fragments are sequence specific.

attempts.rationale: The abstract states that replication termination is largely a passive phenomenon that does not rely on cis-acting sequences, contradicting the claim that most termination events are sequence specific.

claims.claim: Mutant mice lacking SVCT2 have greatly increased ascorbic acid levels in both brain and adrenals.

attempts.rationale: Rather than greatly increased levels, mice deficient in the transporter had undetectable or markedly reduced ascorbic-acid levels in blood and tissues.

claims.claim: Mutations in G-Beta protein GNB2 are present in many cancers, resulting in loss of interaction with G-alpha subunits and concomitant activation of AKT pathway.

attempts.rationale: While the abstract notes recurrent mutations in GNB1 and GNB2 across various human tumors, it specifically describes disruption of G-alpha interactions and downstream signaling effects only for GNB1 rather than GNB2, and does not mention the AKT pathway.

claims.claim: N-terminal cleavage increases success identifying transcription start sites.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses N-terminal acetylation and its rules in Drosophila melanogaster, but does not provide any information regarding the effect of N-terminal cleavage on identifying transcription start sites.

claims.claim: N-terminal cleavage reduces success identifying transcription start sites.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses N-terminal acetylation in Drosophila melanogaster and does not mention transcription start sites or the effect of N-terminal cleavage on their identification.

claims.claim: N348I mutations cause resistance to zidovudine (AZT).

attempts.rationale: The study demonstrates that the N348I mutation decreases zidovudine susceptibility in HIV-1 molecular clones and provides supporting biochemical evidence for its role in zidovudine resistance.

claims.claim: NF2 (Merlin) causes phosphorylation and subsequent cytoplasmic sequestration of YAP in Drosophila by activating LATS1/2 kinases.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses LKB1 and the Hippo-YAP pathway in human cells but does not mention NF2 (Merlin) or Drosophila.

claims.claim: NF2 (Merlin) prevents phosphorylation and subsequent cytoplasmic sequestration of YAP in Drosophila.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses LKB1-MARK signalling controlling the Hippo-YAP pathway in human cells and makes no mention of NF2 (Merlin) or its role in Drosophila.

claims.claim: NFAT4 activation requires IP3R-mediated Ca2+ mobilization.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that NFAT4 activation requires Ca2+ mobilization by nuclear InsP3 (IP3) receptors.

claims.claim: NOX2-independent pathways can generate peroxynitrite by reacting with nitrogen intermediates.

attempts.rationale: The cited abstract mentions peroxynitrite production by MDSCs, but it does not mention NOX2, NOX2-independent pathways, or reactions with nitrogen intermediates.

claims.claim: NR5A2 is important in development of endometrial tissues.

attempts.rationale: Doc 15928989 shows that NR5A2/Lrh-1 is expressed in the endometrium and that reducing its transcript abundance abrogates endometrial decidualization, demonstrating its essential role in endometrial tissue development.

claims.claim: Nanoparticles can be targeted against specific cell types by incorporating aptamers into lipid nanoparticles.

attempts.rationale: The study demonstrates that functionalizing lipid nanoparticles with the osteoblast-specific CH6 aptamer successfully enabled cell-specific targeting and uptake in osteoblasts.

claims.claim: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are released by ANCA-stimulated neutrophils.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that chromatin fibers known as neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are released by ANCA-stimulated neutrophils.

claims.claim: New drugs for tuberculosis often do not penetrate the necrotic portion of a tuberculosis lesion in high concentrations.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses the penetration of specific drugs such as rifampicin and moxifloxacin into necrotic caseum, but it does not make a general claim that new tuberculosis drugs often fail to penetrate necrotic lesions in high concentrations.

claims.claim: Non-invasive ventilation use should be decreased if there is inadequate response to conventional treatment.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses the cost-effectiveness and mortality benefits of non-invasive ventilation for acute exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, but does not state whether non-invasive ventilation use should be decreased if there is inadequate response to conventional treatment.

claims.claim: Normal expression of RUNX1 has tumor-promoting effects.

attempts.rationale: The abstract identifies RUNX1 as a tumor-suppressor gene in T-ALL rather than having tumor-promoting effects.

claims.claim: Obesity decreases life quality.

attempts.rationale: The cited study evaluates the association between body-mass index and mortality/survival, but it does not address life quality.

claims.claim: Obesity is determined solely by environmental factors.

attempts.rationale: Multiple studies demonstrate that genetic influences play a substantial role in determining obesity and body mass index, contradicting the claim that obesity is determined solely by environmental factors.

claims.claim: Occupancy of ribosomes by IncRNAs do not make functional peptides.

attempts.rationale: The study demonstrates that ribosome occupancy alone does not indicate translation into proteins and argues that the vast majority of lincRNAs do not function through encoded proteins.

claims.claim: Occupancy of ribosomes by IncRNAs mirror 5 0-UTRs

attempts.rationale: Sentence 3 demonstrates that classical noncoding RNAs and 5' UTRs show the same ribosome occupancy as large intergenic noncoding RNAs (lincRNAs).

claims.claim: Omnivores produce less trimethylamine N-oxide from dietary I-carnitine than vegetarians.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that omnivorous human subjects produce more TMAO following ingestion of L-carnitine than vegans or vegetarians, contradicting the claim that they produce less.

claims.claim: Only a minority of cells survive development after differentiation into stress-resistant spores.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses social interactions, antagonism, and sporulation efficiency during starvation-induced development in Myxococcus xanthus, but does not provide information about whether only a minority of cells survive development after differentiation into stress-resistant spores.

claims.claim: PD-1 triggering on monocytes reduces IL-10 production by monocytes.

attempts.rationale: The abstract states that triggering of PD-1 expressed on monocytes by PD-L1 induced IL-10 production, directly contradicting the claim that it reduces IL-10 production.

claims.claim: PDPN promotes efficient motility along stromal surfaces by activating the C-type lectin receptor to rearrange the actin cytoskeleton in dendritic cells.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that activation of the C-type lectin receptor CLEC-2 by PDPN rearranges the actin cytoskeleton in dendritic cells to promote efficient motility along stromal surfaces.

claims.claim: PGE 2 promotes intestinal tumor growth by altering the expression of tumor suppressing and DNA repair genes.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that prostaglandin E(2) (PGE(2)) silences certain tumor-suppressor and DNA-repair genes through DNA methylation to promote tumor growth.

claims.claim: PKG-la plays an essential role in expression of pain hypersensitivity in PGK-la knockout mice.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that knockout mice lacking PKG-I specifically in presynaptic nociceptor terminals exhibit marked defects in nociceptive hypersensitivity, showing that PKG-I plays an essential role in regulating pain sensitivity.

claims.claim: PPAR-RXRs are inhibited by PPAR ligands.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses RXR heterodimerization with T3R, RAR, and NGFI-B/Nurr1, but does not mention PPAR, PPAR-RXRs, or PPAR ligands.

claims.claim: PPAR-RXRs can be activated by PPAR ligands.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses RXR heterodimerization with T3R, RAR, and NGFI-B/Nurr1, but does not mention PPAR or whether PPAR-RXRs can be activated by PPAR ligands.

claims.claim: Participating in six months of physical activity improves cognitive functioning.

attempts.rationale: The study concluded that a 6-month program of physical activity provided an improvement in cognition in adults with subjective memory impairment.

claims.claim: Patients in stable partnerships have a faster progression from HIV to AIDS.

attempts.rationale: The study concludes that a stable partnership is associated with a slower, not faster, rate of progression to AIDS or death in HIV-infected patients.

claims.claim: Peroxynitrite is required for nitration of TCR/CD8.

attempts.rationale: The abstract states that nitration of TCR-CD8 is induced by MDSCs through hyperproduction of reactive oxygen species and peroxynitrite, but it does not establish that peroxynitrite is strictly required for this nitration.

claims.claim: Pleiotropic coupling of GLP-1R to intracellular effectors promotes distinct profiles of cellular signaling.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that peptide agonists engage distinct elements of the GLP-1 receptor to achieve effector coupling and biased signaling profiles.

claims.claim: Podocytes are motile and migrate in the presence of injury.

attempts.rationale: Serial multiphoton imaging demonstrated the motility of podocytes and showed that podocytes formed clusters and migrated after injury caused by unilateral ureteral ligation.

claims.claim: Polymeal nutrition reduces cardiovascular mortality.

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses the modeled effects of the Polymeal on reducing cardiovascular disease events, morbidity, and increasing life expectancy, but does not provide direct evidence or results regarding cardiovascular mortality specifically.

claims.claim: Pretreatment with the Arp2/3 inhibitor CK-666 affects lamelliopodia formation.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that pharmacological inhibition of the Arp2/3 complex using the drug CK666 dramatically alters lamellipodial actin architecture and drives a lamellipodial-to-filopodial shape change.

claims.claim: Primary cervical cancer screening with HPV detection has higher longitudinal sensitivity than conventional cytology to detect cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2.

attempts.rationale: While the provided abstracts discuss the cross-sectional detection and relative detection across screening rounds of CIN2 and CIN3 by HPV testing compared to cytology, none evaluate or compare the longitudinal sensitivity specifically for detecting cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2.

claims.claim: Primary pro-inflammatory cytokines induce secondary pro- and anti-inflammatory mediators.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses the genetic influences and inter-individual variability of cytokine responses to bacteria and fungi, but does not mention whether primary pro-inflammatory cytokines induce secondary pro- and anti-inflammatory mediators.

claims.claim: Proteins synthesized at the growth cone are ubiquitinated at a higher rate than proteins from the cell body.

attempts.rationale: The abstract indicates that while most axonal proteins are transported from the soma, locally translated proteins at the growth cone are the primary targets of the ubiquitin-proteasome system.

claims.claim: Pseudogene PTENP1 regulates the expression of PTEN by functioning as an miRNA decoy.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that PTENP1 regulates PTEN levels by testing the hypothesis that RNAs possess a regulatory role through their ability to compete for microRNA binding.

claims.claim: Pyridostatin destabilizes the G - quadruplex in the telomeric region.

attempts.rationale: The abstract directly identifies pyridostatin as a G-quadruplex (G4)-stabilizing compound rather than one that destabilizes G-quadruplexes.

claims.claim: Radioiodine treatment of non-toxic multinodular goitre reduces thyroid volume.

attempts.rationale: The study demonstrates that radioactive iodine treatment in patients with non-toxic multinodular goitre results in a substantial and statistically significant reduction in median thyroid volume.

claims.claim: Rapamycin decreases the concentration of triacylglycerols in fruit flies.

attempts.rationale: The abstract does not mention triacylglycerols or lipid levels in relation to rapamycin treatment in fruit flies.

claims.claim: Rapid phosphotransfer rates govern fidelity in two component systems

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses structural determinants that mediate specificity and allow rapid phosphotransfer in a two-component system, but it does not evaluate whether rapid phosphotransfer rates themselves govern fidelity in two-component systems.

claims.claim: Rapid up-regulation and higher basal expression of interferon-induced genes increase survival of granule cell neurons that are infected by West Nile virus.

attempts.rationale: Although the abstract notes that granule cell neurons express higher levels of certain interferon-stimulated genes conferring enhanced antiviral response, it does not specifically mention West Nile virus, rapid up-regulation, or the survival of granule cell neurons.

claims.claim: Rapid up-regulation and higher basal expression of interferon-induced genes reduce survival of granule cell neurons that are infected by West Nile virus.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions interferon-stimulated genes mediating antiviral effects in granule cell neurons, but does not provide information about their impact on the survival of granule cell neurons infected by West Nile virus.

claims.claim: Recurrent mutations occur frequently within CTCF anchor sites adjacent to oncogenes.

attempts.rationale: The abstract notes that CTCF anchor regions are a frequent site of mutations in cancer cells, but it does not specify whether recurrent mutations occur frequently adjacent to oncogenes.

claims.claim: Reduced responsiveness to interleukin-2 in regulatory T cells is associated with greater resistance to autoimmune diseases such as Type 1 Diabetes.

attempts.rationale: Rather than granting resistance, reduced responsiveness to interleukin-2 is associated with impaired regulatory T cell function and increased susceptibility to autoimmune diseases such as type 1 diabetes.

claims.claim: Replacement of histone H2A with H2A.Z slows gene activation in yeasts by stabilizing +1 nucleosomes.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract discusses the stability of nucleosome core particles containing H3.3 and H2A.Z in vertebrates, but does not provide information about how H2A.Z replacement affects gene activation or +1 nucleosome stability in yeasts.

claims.claim: Ribosomopathies have a low degree of cell and tissue specific pathology.

attempts.rationale: The provided text discusses tissue-specific patterning defects caused by Rpl38 mutations, but it does not make a general claim about whether ribosomopathies have a low degree of cell and tissue specific pathology.

claims.claim: S-nitrosylated GAPDH physiologically transnitrosylates histone deacetylases.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that SNO-GAPDH physiologically transnitrosylates nuclear proteins, including histone deacetylase-2 (HDAC2).

claims.claim: Sildenafil improves erectile function in men who experience sexual dysfunction as a result of the use of SSRI antidepressants.

attempts.rationale: The randomized controlled trial found that sildenafil significantly improved erectile function in men experiencing sexual dysfunction associated with serotonin reuptake inhibitor antidepressants.

claims.claim: Silencing of Bcl2 is important for the maintenance and progression of tumors.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that eliminating (silencing) BCL-2 results in rapid cell death of leukemic cells and prolonged survival, contradicting the claim that silencing BCL-2 maintains tumor progression.

claims.claim: Smc5/6 engagment drives the activation of SUMO E3 ligase Mms21 by ATP-dependent remolding.

attempts.rationale: The abstract demonstrates that Mms21 SUMO ligase activity depends on engagement with the Smc5/6 complex, which physically remodels in an ATP-dependent manner to activate sumoylation.

claims.claim: Statins decrease blood cholesterol.

attempts.rationale: Although statins are mentioned in the title, the abstract text does not state that statins decrease blood cholesterol.

claims.claim: Statins increase blood cholesterol.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions statins only in the title and does not provide information on how statins affect blood cholesterol levels.

claims.claim: Stroke patients with prior use of direct oral anticoagulants have a lower risk of in-hospital mortality than stroke patients with prior use of warfarin.

attempts.rationale: Prior use of non–vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulants (NOACs/DOACs) compared to warfarin was found to be associated with a significantly lower risk of in-hospital mortality among stroke patients with intracerebral hemorrhage.

claims.claim: Subcutaneous fat depots undergo extensive browning processes after cold exposure.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly notes cold-induced 'browning' of subcutaneous fat, where most beige adipocytes arise via de novo differentiation.

claims.claim: Suboptimal nutrition is not predictive of chronic disease

attempts.rationale: The abstract discusses various global risk factors for disease burden—including childhood undernutrition, high BMI, and diets high in sodium—but does not evaluate whether suboptimal nutrition specifically is or is not predictive of chronic disease.

claims.claim: Synaptic activity enhances local release of brain derived neurotrophic factor from postsynaptic dendrites.

attempts.rationale: The study demonstrates that synaptic activity, specifically glutamate uncaging and sLTP induction, triggers rapid and local BDNF release from stimulated postsynaptic dendritic spines.

claims.claim: T regulatory cells (tTregs) lacking αvβ8 are more adept at suppressing pathogenic T-cell responses during active inflammation.

attempts.rationale: Contrary to the claim, Treg cells lacking expression of integrin αvβ8 were found to be unable to suppress pathogenic T-cell responses during active inflammation.

claims.claim: TCR/CD3 microdomains are a required to induce the immunologic synapse to activate T cells.

attempts.rationale: The cited abstract mentions TCR-CD3 clustering, conformational changes, and T cell activation, but it does not mention the immunologic synapse or TCR/CD3 microdomains.

claims.claim: TNFAIP3 is a tumor suppressor in glioblastoma.

attempts.rationale: Rather than acting as a tumor suppressor, the study indicates that A20 (TNFAIP3) functions as a tumor enhancer in glioma by maintaining and promoting the survival of glioblastoma stem cells.

claims.claim: Taking 400mg of α-tocopheryl acetate helps to prevent prostate cancer.

attempts.rationale: A large randomized controlled trial found that vitamin E supplementation had no effect on the incidence of prostate cancer and did not reduce the risk of the disease.

claims.claim: Taxation of sugar-sweetened beverages had no effect on the incidence rate of type II diabetes in India.

attempts.rationale: A 20% excise tax on sugar-sweetened beverages in India was modeled to reduce type 2 diabetes incidence by 1.6% to 2.5%, directly contradicting the claim that taxation had no effect.

claims.claim: Teaching hospitals do not provide better care than non-teaching hospitals.

attempts.rationale: A systematic review indicates that teaching healthcare structures typically do not do better than nonteaching ones and that teaching status does not markedly improve patient outcomes.

claims.claim: Tetraspanin-3 is a causative factor in the development of acute myelogenous leukemia

attempts.rationale: The study demonstrates that Tetraspanin 3 deletion impairs leukemia stem cell self-renewal and disease propagation in mouse models, while its inhibition blocks AML patient sample growth, identifying it as an important regulator and oncogenic factor in acute myelogenous leukemia.

claims.claim: The DdrB protein from Deinococcus radiodurans is an alternative SSB.

attempts.rationale: DdrB is identified as a single-stranded DNA-binding protein with a novel fold structurally distinct from other characterized single-stranded binding (SSB) proteins, serving standard SSB functions alongside specialized roles.

claims.claim: The PPR MDA5 has two N-terminal CARD domains.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract mentions MDA5 as a RIG-I-like receptor, but does not state whether it has two N-terminal CARD domains.

claims.claim: The PRR MDA5 has a central DExD/H RNA helices domain.

attempts.rationale: The provided abstract mentions that MDA5 is an RLR involved in sensing RNA virus infections, but it does not mention whether it contains a central DExD/H RNA helicase domain.

claims.claim: The PRR MDA5 is a sensor of RNA virus infection.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that the RIG-I-like receptor MDA5 plays a major role in pathogen sensing of RNA virus infection.

claims.claim: The US health care system can save up to $750 million if 7% of patients waiting for kidney transplants participate in the optimized national kidney paired donation program.

attempts.rationale: The abstract explicitly states that if only 7% of patients awaiting kidney transplantation participated in an optimized national KPD program, the health care system could save as much as $750 million.

claims.claim: The YAP1 and TEAD complex tanslocates into the nucleus where it interacts with transcription factors and DNA-binding proteins that modulate target gene transcription.

attempts.rationale: The abstract mentions that YAP undergoes nuclear translocation and interacts with TEAD transcription factors to regulate gene expression, but it does not state that a YAP1 and TEAD complex translocates into the nucleus to interact with other transcription factors.
